title: Asymptotic profiles and large-time behavior for 3D micropolar fluid equations with possibly vanishing spin viscosity
summary: We consider 3D micropolar flows with possible vanishing spin viscosity and investigate the decay of the energy for large times. We compute first the exact $L^2$-asymptotic profile, as $t\to+\infty$, for solutions to the linear 3D micropolar equations, up to the second order. For the nonlinear micropolar system, we first establish the existence of restricted Leray solutions. This new notion of solutions is required because it is not known whether the weak finite energy solutions verify a strong energy inequality.
